written_by: Claude Code, for Ryan Saleh to check
notes: Political science for Explore (spec 21), batch 2. Every name and description is in Stackd's own words; nothing is copied from UC's page. C-ID numbers, the template number and revision, the degree name, the unit totals and the campus major names are copied exactly. UC pathway: the Political Science Transfer Pathway page on admission.universityofcalifornia.edu (it states no term or year; academic_year is the year it was checked). TMC: template #1009, the PDF in source_url. An option with no C-ID number has an empty c_id, which needs the migration 20261031120000_explore_option_no_c_id.sql before this file can be imported. Topics in both pathways (Counts for both): polisci-core-1, polisci-core-2, polisci-core-3. The 3 core rows are shared: UC and the template ask for 3 of the same 4 courses, so each pick counts on both sides. Choosing 3 of 4 is written as 3 rows because a TMC row's units must match its smallest option, and a row needs one status. The other rows are Cal State only. Check every row against its source, delete each todo once confirmed, fill in retrieved_at on both pathways, then run: npm run import -- data/raw/explore/political-science.json --dry-run
